tasks.label: 开发：启动 MgRead（自动选择设备）
发布：打包 APK（Release）
dependsOn: 整理：APK 到根目录 build

tasks.label: 整理：APK 到根目录 build
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $source = Join-Path '${workspaceFolder}' 'build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk'; $destination = Join-Path '${workspaceFolder}' 'build/mg_read-release.apk'; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $source)) { throw "找不到 APK：$source" }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path -Parent $destination) | Out-Null; Copy-Item -LiteralPath $source -Destination $destination -Force; Write-Host "APK 已复制到：$destination"; Start-Process -FilePath 'explorer.exe' -ArgumentList ('/select,"' + $destination + '"')

tasks.label: 发布：打包 Windows EXE（Release）
dependsOn: 整理：Windows 到根目录 build

tasks.label: 准备：Windows Runtime 资源
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $runtimeRoot = Join-Path '${workspaceFolder}' 'packages/mg_read_node_runtime'; $nodeBin = Join-Path $runtimeRoot 'tools/node-v24.16.0-win-x64'; $env:PATH = $nodeBin + ';' + $env:PATH; Push-Location $runtimeRoot; try { & (Join-Path $nodeBin 'npm.cmd') run stage:flutter-windows; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } } finally { Pop-Location }

tasks.label: 整理：Windows 到根目录 build
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $source = Join-Path '${workspaceFolder}' 'build/windows/x64/runner/Release'; $destination = Join-Path '${workspaceFolder}' 'build/mg_read-windows-release'; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $source)) { throw "找不到 Windows Release 目录：$source" }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $destination | Out-Null; Copy-Item -Path (Join-Path $source '*') -Destination $destination -Recurse -Force; $executable = Join-Path $destination 'mg_read.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $executable)) { throw "找不到 Windows 可执行文件：$executable" }; Write-Host "Windows Release 已复制到：$destination"; Start-Process -FilePath 'explorer.exe' -ArgumentList ('/select,"' + $executable + '"')
